g.text: Two candidates frozen by downstream losses across both view budgets. Both are about 15m to the right of ego; all original missing rays are restored.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #83533c

g.text: Panels (c,d) show nearest same-class boxes, not verified track identities. Dense pedestrian groups and small footprints make IoU sensitive.
